notes: Built with depot 1.2.7 for tiles, buildings, roads and runways. Demand generated from LODES 2023 with rslurry's subwaybuilder-US-demand-data and routed via a local OSRM server (MLD, car profile); 99.5% of pops routed, median commute 19.6 min/17.4 km. Special-demand coordinates verified individually against OpenStreetMap and primary sources. Demand points carrying neither residents nor jobs were stripped before packaging.
